items.name: 01b-downstairs-cloakroom-hero
items.prompt: A real small downstairs cloakroom in a British house, seen from the doorway: on the back wall a boxed-in cistern wall about one metre high with a white oak shelf on top, a white wall-hung toilet fixed to the front of that boxing with a plain white flush plate on the boxing face above the toilet; on the right side wall a small wall-hung basin with a brass tap and a round brass mirror above it; sage green tongue-and-groove panelling to half height, cream walls above, a small frosted window, terracotta hexagon floor tiles, a small trailing plant on the shelf. Realistic proportions: a standard-size toilet about 36 cm wide and a small basin about 40 cm wide, everything at true real-world scale. Plain white ceramic sanitaryware and unbranded brass fittings with no visible logos. Shot like a real estate interior photo with a 24 mm lens at standing eye height, natural daylight, true-to-life materials, slight natural imperfections, no CGI look.
